www.linkedin.com/in/dagadu-borse-ba905968

Languages: English, Hindi, Marathi

Professional Summary

Senior Java Developer with 10+ years of experience in designing and developing scalable enterprise applications across BFSI, Telecom, and Banking domains. I am proficient in Java 17, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, AWS, Kafka, Redis, Oracle, and Kubernetes. Adept in cloud-native application design, CI/CD pipelines, and system monitoring using SRE tools. Experienced in team leadership, Agile methodology, and end-to-end SDLC ownership.

Technical Skills

Languages	Java 8/17, SQL, Basic Python

Backend Technologies	Spring Boot 3, Spring 6, Microservices, Hibernate, Spring JPA, Spring Security Cloud Platforms	 AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, ECS, ECR, CloudWatch, SQS, SNS), Kubernetes Frontend Technologies            HTML, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, Ajax, JSON

Web Services	REST, SOAP

Databases	Couchbase, Oracle, MySQL

DevOps / Tools	Git, Bitbucket, Jenkins, Maven, TeamCity, JIRA

AI Developer Tools	GitHub Copilot, GitHub Copilot Chat, AutoX (Amdocs Internal), Cursor (MCP servers)

Authentication	Okta, Keycloak

Testing Frameworks	JUnit, Mockito, PowerMockito, Integration Testing, Karate Automation (Cucumber)

Code Quality Tools	SonarQube, Jacoco

Monitoring Tools	Grafana, Telegraf, InfluxDB, CloudWatch

Logging Frameworks	Log4J2, Splunk, Kibana

Work Experience

Software Development Specialist - Amdocs Development Centre India LLP (Oct 2021 - Present) Skills: Java 17, Microservices, Spring Boot 3, Spring JPA, JWT, REST APIs, Kafka, Couchbase, Redis, Elasticsearch, Keycloak, JUnit, Mockito/PowerMockito, OCP, Grafana, Actuator, Kubernetes based infrastructure.

Project: CatalogOne (Telecom)

Designed and developed robust and scalable core APIs leveraging microservices architecture with Spring Boot 3, implementing Kafka-based messaging for efficient publishing of business requests and real-time communication with downstream consumers.

Implemented Redis caching, reducing data retrieval time by 30%, JWT-based security.

Built a Release Queue Mechanism to manage publishing of business requests, including logic for priority-based

BR (Business Requests) processing.

Developed APIs for incremental and full release details using pagination support, improving data navigation for large datasets with speed by 25%.

Instrumented Spring Boot Actuator metrics to track the status of BR publications — including success, in- progress, and failed events across all consumers.

Integrated metrics with Grafana dashboards, enabling real-time visibility into API behavior and publishing progress.

Sr. Software Engineer - TRANSFORMHUB PRIVATE LIMITED. (Dec 2019 - Oct 2021)

Client: Singlife - Insurance & Investment Singapore.

Skills: Java 8, Spring Boot, Spring JPA, Spring Security, Apache Camel, REST APIs, AWS (S3, SQS, SNS, ECS, ECR, Lambda – Python), MySQL, Okta, Keycloak, CodeCommit, TYK API Gateway, TeamCity, Shell Scripting, Karate (Gherkin), Grafana, Telegraf, InfluxDB, CloudWatch, Slack

Project: Advisor Portal & Customer Onboarding – Insurance APIs & Real-Time Microservices

Designed and implemented customer onboarding flows in the Advisor Portal including complete term insurance policy purchase APIs with rider add/remove functionality.

Migrated legacy APIs from Apache Camel to modern Spring Boot REST APIs, improving maintainability and performance.

Led authentication migration from Keycloak to Okta, including custom user migration scripts and end-to-end transition plan.

Used AWS Lambda (Python), SQS, and SNS for building event-driven, real-time systems and ECS for containerized deployments.

Managed API lifecycle on TYK API Gateway, including policy creation, authentication, and rate limiting

configurations.

Implemented robust CI/CD pipelines using TeamCity and integrated Karate Automation Testing using Gherkin syntax.

Developed shell scripts (cron jobs) for scheduled automation and custom alerts.

Set up SRE monitoring dashboards using Grafana, Telegraf, InfluxDB, CloudWatch, and integrated alerts into

Slack for operational visibility.

Active contributor in peer reviews, client communication, and production support with detailed RCA

documentation.

Sr. Software Engineer- AURION PRO SOLUTIONS LTD. (Aug 2017 - Dec 2019)

Skills: Java 8, Spring, Hibernate, Spring Batch, AngularJS, Eclipse Kepler, WebSphere, Oracle DB, SVN.

Project: Corporate Banking APIs & Fixed Deposit Services (AU Small Finance Bank).

Designed and implemented value-based transaction routing logic for automatic switching between RTGS, NEFT, and IMPS based on transaction amount limits and bank cut-off times.

Developed complete Fixed Deposit Liquidation flow, including business validation, user actions, and back-office triggers.

Contributed to the Cash Management System (CMS) for processing trade assets and financial transactions across various set types.

Implemented the Cheque Book Order Service API, integrating customer requests into the bank’s service ecosystem.

Integrated new reporting services for generating client-specific financial reports.

Built Spring Batch jobs to push all transaction details to the core banking system using a structured first-leg and second-leg processing mechanism.

Designed and handled reversal transaction flows to manage and correct failed or partially processed transactions.

Resolved production issues and delivered enhancements with root cause analysis (RCA) and peer-reviewed solutions.

Software Engineer- Trimax IT & Services (Jul 2016 - Aug 2017) Client: Calcutta State Transportation Corporation (Government Transportation). Skills: Java 7, J2EE, Spring, Hibernate, jQuery, Ajax, MySQL

Project: Transport Management System – Waybill & Fuel Tracking

Worked on Waybill Creation Flow, tracking ticket issuance and maintaining collection amounts at the end of each vehicle route.

Designed and developed the Fuel Consumption Information Module to track vehicle fuel usage for performance monitoring and optimization.

Participated in requirement gathering and analysis sessions with business analysts to ensure business logic accuracy.

Contributed to core module development, focusing on data consistency and user workflow in the ticketing system.

Software Engineer- Aerus Infotech Pvt Ltd (May 2015 - Jun 2016)

Project: Event Management System

Industry: Event & Exhibition Management

Environment: Java7, J2EE, Spring MVC, Hibernate, jQuery, Ajax, MySQL Database

Developed modules for event creation and exhibition data flow, managing complete lifecycle of events including exhibitors, stalls, and visitors.

Implemented Stall Booking functionality with size selection, pricing logic, and integrated banner creation order module with a responsive Web UI.

Participated in requirement gathering, analysis, and planning, closely working with business teams to align functionality with real-world event logistics.

Designed and developed core backend modules in Spring MVC and Hibernate with dynamic data binding and validations.

Maintained and enhanced application modules by fixing bugs, UI issues, and data inconsistencies in real time.

Achievements

Implemented a high-performance reconciliation report to compare 15 million entities using

CompletableFuture multi-threading, reducing report generation time to under 4 minutes.

Successfully led the development of scalable microservices architecture for high-performance applications in Telecom and Insurance industries.

Implemented Redis caching mechanisms to enhance data retrieval speeds and reduce database load.

Streamlined CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments using TeamCity and ECS.

Improved system reliability and monitoring through SRE tools like Grafana and CloudWatch.

Education

B.E. in Information Technology, Mumbai University, May 2014, HSC. Maharashtra Board, Feb 2009

SSC. Secondary Board, Mar 2007

Certifications

Apache Kafka Series - Learn Apache Kafka v3

Couchbase Fundamentals

Java Multithreading, Concurrency & Performance Optimization
